name: AI Video Generator
author: Saadhyam AI
description: Create marketing videos using AI-generated scripts, storyboards, voiceovers, captions, images, and exportable projects.

actions.name: Generate Video Script
actions.description: Generate a full video script including hook, narration and CTA from product and keyword inputs

actions.name: Generate Storyboard
actions.description: Generate scene-by-scene storyboard layout from an existing script

actions.name: Generate Scene Images
actions.description: Generate placeholder image metadata for each storyboard scene

actions.name: Generate Voiceover
actions.description: Synthesise a placeholder voiceover configuration for a given script narration

actions.name: Generate Subtitles & Captions
actions.description: Generate timed subtitle entries from narration text and scene durations

actions.name: Preview Video Timeline
actions.description: Return a structured preview manifest combining scenes, voice, captions, images and music

actions.name: Export Video Project
actions.description: Package all project data into exportable TXT, CSV and JSON formats

actions.name: Plugin Health Check
actions.description: Verify the plugin is responsive and all sub-modules are operational
